sweepCuesReason.definitions: Hoyle's backgammon article defines its vocabulary by using it -- the points are named ace through six and the tables inner, outer and home, in the sentences that state the moves (`point-designations`, `direction-of-travel`, #13). No definitional verb occurs anywhere on pages 271-280: `means`, `is defined as`, `refers to`, `the term` and `for the purposes of` are absent from the whole extent, in the reached units as well as the unaccounted ones. The definitions sweep therefore fires on nothing here, and the `vocabulary` sweep is the one that carries this corpus's naming.
sweepCuesReason.exceptions: `except`, `unless`, `other than`, `notwithstanding` and `provided that` do not occur anywhere on pages 271-280. Hoyle conditions a rule by restating it in the affirmative for the other case -- "If the winner has borne off all his men before his adversary has begun to do the same" -- so the corpus states its exceptions as further rules and the map holds them as entries of their own.
